nativeAudioRegression: Chromium removed only AudioParam.cancelAndHoldAtTime; retained native context and parameter scheduling. Real touch stop-fire, real enemy contact damage, PALISADE warning, pause and resume passed without game error or console/pageerror. Native duck ramp was observed.
webkitLimitation: Windows Playwright WebKit exposes neither AudioContext, webkitAudioContext nor AudioParam. Native audio-specific regression skipped; other WebKit touch and silent fallback flows passed. Actual iPhone/Android audio remains unverified.
